taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Bank-road (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 640 | 5.21 | 5.21
2 | 934 | 8.58 | 13.8
3 | 2594 | 84.1 | 97.9
4 | 4386 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as AA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Bank-road (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: AA-type
Aquifer depth: 13.8 - 97.9 m
Recommendation: Target the weathered zone identified between 13.8m and 97.9m. Drill to a total depth of approximately 100m to ensure intersection with the productive layer.
